summary: xAI released Grok Imagine Video 1.5, an updated image-to-video model with faster generation speed and new synchronized audio, motion and workflow features, now generally available via the Imagine API and consumer apps.

mechanisms.reason: The model doubles video generation speed for the same output length and resolution, indicating reduced compute or time per generated unit.
mechanisms.quote: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Fast almost doubles generation speed: it produces 6-second, 720p videos in about 25 seconds, down from 40+ seconds in our previous model.

practices.reason: A production video generation model now offers synchronized audio/speech, more coherent motion, and nearly double the generation speed, changing what is viable for real-time creative pipelines.
practices.quote: 1.5 improves across every dimension that matters for real creative work: Audio and speech Sound effects, ambience, and dialogue are generated in the same pass and land on the action.

practices.reason: The model has moved out of preview to general availability under a new API model identifier, requiring teams on the preview endpoint to migrate.
practices.quote: Imagine Video 1.5 is out of preview and generally available in the xAI API as grok-imagine-video-1.5 .

practices.reason: A parallel multi-agent generation feature is described but without a stated performance gain or enough implementation detail to build from.
practices.quote: Kick off multiple agents in parallel on your projects. Instead of waiting for one generation to finish before starting the next, you can run several prompts at once and let them work for you.
